notes.title: Patch 1.2.2.0
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes for version 1.2.2.0 which aims to homogenize the account and legal documents handling with our other games.
[list]
[*] Changed the account creation process for Paradox Accounts to more clearly inform players of Paradox Interactive's Terms of Use and Privacy policy.
[*] Players are now more clearly informed when changes occur in Paradox Interactive's Privacy Policy.
[*] Players can now access the Paradox Interactive's Privacy Policy from the main menu.
[*] Added an indicator in the main menu that shows which Paradox Account a player is logged in to.
[*] Added the ability to unlink a Paradox Account, from a player's Steam account, in the main menu.
[*] Players can now reset their Paradox Account password from the log in screen.
[*] Fixed a bug causing animals to use regular blood gore when the Piñata Madness artifact is active.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 1.1.1.0, "Spell Again, Again - Part 2"
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/S5s3kmi.jpg[/img]

Hi all! Today we have released the 1.1.1.0 update for Magicka 2 and it contains a lot of good stuff which we hope you are going to enjoy.

Read on for all the goodies contained within today's update!


[h1]- Server Browser[/h1]

A Server Browser has been added to easily find and join open games


[h1]- New Magick: “Teleport”[/h1]

Can be found on chapter 2


[h1]- New Magick: “Thunderbolt”[/h1]

Can be found on chapter 3


[h1]- Animated element queue[/h1]

The spell queue will now animate added elements and also better show when queued elements are lost


[h1]- Ask for revive functionality[/h1]

Dead players can now ask for a revive. This can be turned on/off from the “Audio” settings menu


[h1]- Magicks templates[/h1]

You can now set your favourite Magicks element combination as a template in classic Magicka 1 style. Simply scroll the mousewheel to select your favourite Magick. Gamepad players can bring up the magick context menu (LB+Dpad) and set/clear templates from here.


[h1]- Damage report on defeat[/h1]

The defeat screen now displays a recap of damage taken and where the damage came from together with useful tips on how to do better!


[h1]- New Loading Screens and Hints[/h1]


[h1]- Distinguished Special/Hard Enemies[/h1]

The harder enemies in the game are now easier to spot in the action


[h1]- The “Higherland Breeze” Magick[/h1]

Now freezes water


[h1]- The “Sacrifice” Magick[/h1]

Has been completely reworked


[h1]- Mine Spells[/h1]

Mines have been graphically enhanced and had their push/elevate effect increased


[h1]- Lightning Spells[/h1]

Lightning spells have been graphically enhanced and received some minor tweaks


[h1]- Imbued Earth Projectiles[/h1]

Earth projectiles imbued with other elements have been reworked. These now scale in damage and area of effect size depending on number of elements used while also taking into account gear modifiers


[h1]- Scaling Beams[/h1]

Beams now scale in width depending on amount of elements used


[h1]- AI Enemy Spellcasters[/h1]

The enemy spellcasters now make more use of the newly added spell combinations


[h1]- The “Join Friends” Menu[/h1]

Has been improved


[h1]- Melee Damage[/h1]

The melee damage system has been overhauled, including weapon imbuements


[h1]- Player Movement Speed[/h1]

The base movement speed for players has been increased


[h1]- Novas[/h1]

Explosions created by crossed beams with opposing elements now scale in damage and range depending on amount of elements used and deal elemental damage depending on the type of Nova


[h1]- Pure Poison Imbuement[/h1]

Pure poison on weapons now last multiple hits


[h1]- Earth/Ice Armor Spells[/h1]

Armors containing Earth/Ice now protect against knockdown, push, elevate and channeling interruption


[h1]- Logged in Paradox Account Visibility[/h1]

Moved currently logged in Paradox account visibility to the settings menu


[h1]- Focus Generation[/h1]

Focus generation has been increased when playing together with other players


[h1]- Magick Quickslot Cooldowns[/h1]

Tier 2, 3 and 4 Magicks have had their quickslot cooldowns reduced


[h1]- Rebindable ComboKeys[/h1]

Players can now rebind the SHIFT, ALT and CTRL keys as single press keys. Keep in mind any other keybindings you might have that use these as combokeys


[h1]- The “Concussion” Magick[/h1]

Has been buffed


[h1]- The “Push” Magick[/h1]

Has been buffed


[h1]- Ice Shards[/h1]

Damage has been reduced


[h1]- Fissures[/h1]

Damage has been increased


[h1]- Chapter 2[/h1]

Has been rebalanced


[h1]- Chapter 3[/h1]

Has been re-balanced


[h1]- A lot of bug fixing has been done![/h1]

notes.title: Magicka 2: Spell Balance Beta patch notes 13/10
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have updated the Magicka 2: Spell Balance Beta!

You can find it in your library right here on steam.
Here is the list for the beta update that was released today, many bug fixes and other cool stuff have been added.

[b]Added[/b]
Ask for revive - Dead players can ask for a revive, also visible in the player ui
Magicks template - you can now have a template just like in Magicka 1
Display death reason/recap on defeat screen
More hints in loading screens

[b]Updated[/b]
Increased base movement speed
Novas scale size+damage scale - depends on amount of elements
Pure poison imbuement - does not get removed after 1 attack
Earth/Ice armor protect against knockdown - depending on amount of elements used
Moved visible bound Paradox account - Now visible in settings menu only

[b]Rebalanced[/b]
Chapter 2 + boss fight
Chapter 3
Ice shards - reduced damage a bit

We have also fixed a lot of bugs!

notes.title: FREE "Spell Again...Again!" Update (and some snazzy new DLC)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/S5s3kmi.jpg[/img]

Hi Wizards!

Exciting news to share today!  Today we introduce a huge re-vamp (totally no reference to Vlad there) of our spell system as well as release some exciting new DLC!  First of all watch the below video and then read on for the full breakdown of what you can expect to see in today's update!

https://youtu.be/-ehtQ5F4L_U


[h1]Free Spell Update[/h1]
- [b]Improved Spell System and Effects.[/b]  There are now even more spell combinations to make use of, most of the existing spells have had a graphical overhaul.

- [b]Added Steam and Ice as Individual Elements.[/b]  Just as it was in Magicka 1 these will take up one slot in the element queue:

[list][*]Steam is made from Water and Fire
[*]Ice is created from Water and Cold[/list]

- [b]New Element! Poison![/b] As above, this will take up one slot in the element queue.  Poison is created from Death and Water.

- [b]Added Poison State.[/b]  When poisoned, the target will take damage over time.  Damage done is dictated by the target's total health and the amount of Poison applied, the target will also become slowed. The poisoned state can be extended by applying more Poison to the target. The poisoned state can be removed by applying the Life element.

- [b]Changed Ice Projectiles.[/b]  Pure Ice is now a channeled spell, while Ice + Earth will work as it did before the change.

- [b]Changed Projectile Charge Time.[/b]  Earth and Ice + Earth have had their charge time reduced, meaning they will reach full effect faster. Damage for these spells has been re-balanced to work with this change.

- [b]Re-balanced Mines.[/b]  Mines now deal more base damage and reach their full damage faster.

 - [b]Changed Earth and Ice armor to also Reduce Push Received.[/b]   When using an Earth or Ice armor, you will now also be more resistant to push effects . The amount of resistance depends on the amount of elements used when creating the armor.

- [b]Changed Pure Shield.[/b]  Duration has been increased, and will decrease faster when taking magic damage.

- [b]Re-balanced Barriers and Elemental Walls.[/b]  Physical barriers (Earth and Ice) now have a longer duration. They have also received a buff to the amount of damage they do when imbued with other elements.

- [b]Overhauled the Challenge Experience.[/b]  Reworked the challenge menu and added leader-boards. 

There are also two bugfixes included:

- [b]Mine Damage on Clients Fixed.[/b]  Fixed an issue where clients mines would always deal damage as if they were fully charged.

- [b]Fixed Sometimes not Getting Achievement for Completing Campaign.[/b]  This issue should now be fixed and you should be able to get the achievements. 

[h1]New DLC![/h1]

[b]The Magicka 2 Gates of Midgård Challenge Pack[/b]  ($3.99) A set of three new Challenge Maps, perfect for sampling new spells

http://store.steampowered.com//app/393830

[b]The Magicka 2 Three Cardinals Robe Pack[/b]  ($4.99) A stylish new selection of wizard-wear (not stain resistant; highly flammable; do not eat). Three robe and item sets are included, each with their own theme.

http://store.steampowered.com//app/393831

- New Element! Poison!
- Added Poison State.

- Changed Projectile Charge Time. Earth and Ice + Earth have had their charge time reduced, meaning they will reach full effect faster. Damage for these spells has been re-balanced to work with this change.
- Re-balanced Mines. Mines now deal more base damage and reach their full damage faster.

- Changed Earth and Ice armor to also Reduce Push Received. When using an Earth or Ice armor, you will now also be more resistant to push effects . The amount of resistance depends on the amount of elements used when creating the armor.
- Changed Pure Shield. Duration has been increased, and will decrease faster when taking magic damage.

- Re-balanced Barriers and Elemental Walls. Physical barriers (Earth and Ice) now have a longer duration. They have also received a buff to the amount of damage they do when imbued with other elements.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.5r2
notes.content:
After receiving further feedback from our players, we have tweaked how the resurrection knockback effect works. 

Players resurrecting other players will no longer trigger this effect.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.5 is Here!
notes.content:
We have a whole bunch of fixes and general quality of life improvements in todays update.  Check below for the full breakdown!

[h1]Added Push effect when revived[/h1]
When you are revived a push effect will move away enemies & friends.

[h1]Added Hold to move in settings[/h1]
You are now able to turn on Hold to move which allows you to only move your wizard while holding down your mouse button. While using Click to move pressing CTRL will stop your current movement.

[h1]Now able to queue elements while airborne[/h1]
You can now queue spells while airborne. 

[h1]Fixed behavior of “Surprise Me”[/h1]
You will now randomly join any of the four difficulties when selecting this alternative in join game.

[h1]Fixed perma-slow bug[/h1]
This has been fixed and should not happen any more. 

[h1]Crash switching between fullscreen and windowed mode (ALT+ENTER)[/h1]
Removed the ALT+ENTER command to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode, you can still use F1 to switch between windowed mode and fullscreen.

[h1]Fixed issues that occurred when changing resolution[/h1]
The resolution should not mess up anymore when switching between borderless fullscreen and fullscreen.

[h1]Correct custom keybindings in dialogues[/h1]
The correct key/inputs will now be displayed in dialogues. 

[h1]Now able to remove any guest player when in someone else's game[/h1]
If you join another player’s game and accidentally add a guest player, you can now remove them. 

[h1]Fixed healing not repeating if using a re-bound self-cast key[/h1]
If you had changed your self-cast key then healing would not repeat while holding that key, this should now work properly. 

[h1]Fixed Private Session could be triggered in the equipment menu[/h1]
You will no longer be able to accidentally trigger Private Session whilst you are in the equipment menu.

[h1]Fixed Latency not being considered when searching and joining games[/h1]
The game will now take latency in consideration when you are searching for a joinable game. 

[h1]Fixed clients sound being muted a few seconds when transitioning between loading screen and in-game[/h1]
The clients sound should no longer be muted when transitioning between load screen and in-game.

[h1]Fixed sound effects not playing until a unit dies whilst being client[/h1]
The clients should now be able to hear sound effects at all times.

[h1]Fixed casting shields and mines[/h1]
You can now cast shields and mines behind you whilst walking forward.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.4 is live!
notes.content:
Greetings wizards!

We've been hard at work bringing you fixes, changes and improvements to Magicka 2, with no further ado - here are today's patch notes.

[B]1.0.1.4 (PC)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Keybinding
[LIST]

[/LIST]

[/LIST]
Please let us know if you encounter any new issues with this patch!

Regards,
The Magicka 2 Team

notes.title: 1.0.1.3 Arriving Shortly!
notes.content:
Any minute now the patch should find its way to you via the Magick of Steam.  Today's patch mostly focuses on quality of life changes, see below for the full run-down!

[h1]Disconnection-handling in Single Player[/h1]
Players that disconnect from steam should now be able to continue playing in offline mode.

[h1]Game settings in the Pause menu[/h1]
You can now change settings in the pause menu

[h1]Fixed issue with Challenge Mode enemies not awarding score[/h1]
Now you will get points if enemies fall into holes or gets killed by each other. 

[h1]That Other Forest bridge[/h1]
Previously if you joined a game in progress where the bridge had already been lowered it would not show as such to you.
The bridge should now be properly synced when a player joins after the bridge has been lowered.

[h1]Improved Waterwheel fight[/h1]
The waterwheel have been updated to give the players more hints on what they should do (see the cut scene).  This should make things much easier for those new to this particular encounter.

[h1]Fixed damage output of weapon-imbued Water+Shield+Death+Earth[/h1]
Using this combination should now give the expected amount (more) of damage

[h1]Retry button added to pause menu in trials & challenges[/h1]
If you got off to a rocky start and are chasing that high score, you can now reset and get back to the action quicker!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is the patch notes for Patch 1.0.1.1

[b] Patch 1.0.1.1
Issues addressed in this patch [/b]

[b] Added a way to change your keybindings
This can be changed in your user settings file [/b]
That can be found in your %AppData%\ParadoxInteractive\Magicka2
[i] You can get there by pressing Windows button + R and type in  %AppData%\ParadoxInteractive\Magicka2 [/i]

[b] Changing key bindings [/b]
Keybinding guide can be found in this thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/238370/discussions/0/615085406659895580/

Any text editor will work, but we recommend something like Notepad++. 
To change bindings simply: 
Find the key you want to change for example 
[code]
    arcane = {
            key = "s"
            state = "pressed"
        }
[/code]
here you can simply change it to p 
[code]
    arcane = {
            key = "p"
            state = "pressed"
        }
[/code]

Save the changes.
Start the game and the key should now be bound to the new key.

[b]The settings file changes is our first solution until we have created a ingame interface for it.[/b]

[b] Good to know. [/b]
- There is nothing that prevents binding the same key to multiple inputs. 
- No sanity checks (you can bind non-existing keys).
- The padps4 section is not used at all.
- Activate Toggle Magick is not used at all. 
- Activate is not used at all.
- Changes in the keybinding won't reflect in the tutorial or ingame HUD.
- Keybindings do not affect the menu, for example you can't rebind pause it will still use the esc key for pausing the game.

[u] - You can always revert to the default setting by removing the keybindings block from the configuration or deleting your whole settings file. [/u]

[b] Unable to communicate with Paradox server  [/b]
Fixed some issues that stopped some user from connecting to the paradox servers.

[b] Wrong number of orchestra soundtracks  [/b]
There was a mistake made in the document, there was only 21 tracks recorded for the orchestral versions. We have updated the pdf to reflect this.

[b] Offline play should now work as intended.  [/b]
Some people had crashes/freezes when pressing space bar. We have made changes to how bad connection and offline mode on steam is being handled.

Added a way to change your keybindings
This can be changed in your user settings file

tags.bug: Fixed some issues that stopped some user from connecting to the paradox servers.

Some people had crashes/freezes when pressing space bar. We have made changes to how bad connection and offline mode on steam is being handled.

notes.title: New patch for Magicka: Wizard Wars is LIVE now!
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

PLEASE NOTE: Servers are down for maintenance. We expect them to be up and running some time this afternoon (CET). Thank you for your patience.

We really wanted to get some bigger balance changes in before we patched, unfortunately though some extra-thorough last-minute QA meant we didn't have the resources needed.  As such please see what we DID fit in below:

[Magicks] Geyser and tornado now has longer telegraphs, tornados speed increased, both magicks now have shorter duration, shorter air time for caught players and longer cast-animation (from 0.8sec to 2sec).

[Magicks] Fixed proper teleport settings (3 years in the making), changed max distance from 10 to 7.5m, min from 2 to 1m.

[Spells] Lightning is now blocked by storms and not barriers, initial arc width reduced from 37.5 to 30 degrees.

As I said, we DID have some other changes on the cards, I'll try and get NDKarlsson to pop onto the forums with a post and we can have a proper chat about them. :)

Additionally, these are the changes you will see rolling out today.

[h1]New Mastery Progression Tree[/h1]
We've completely reworked how a Wizard progresses in their pursuit of battleground domination.  In addition to the store format we have now we have implemented a "Mastery" tree. 


Simply put, it's a great big beast of a tree that allows you to choose where you want to specialise your Wizard, you can choose to build along a particular element specialisation, or work on many at the same time.  The choice is yours.


Mastery Tokens will be awarded at the end of round, so those unscrupulous Wizards who tend to flee from battle will wish to re-think their decisions.

Important Note:  Any existing items you own, regardless where they may appear in the Mastery tree are still owned and useable by you.  Anything you owned/could use before theses changes remains the same.

[h1]Random Loot at Round End[/h1]
On the subject of reasons to stick around until the end of a round, random free stuff!

Now at the end of round you can be gifted with any number of goodies, it may be crowns, it could be Mastery Tokens, it could be a robe.  Who doesn't like extra chances at shiny stuff? :)

[h1]Level Locks Removed, All Items Purchased With Crowns[/h1]
This one is a biggie.  All level locks have been removed from items, as have real-money prices.  From here on out all purchases will be made with Gold Crowns.

We heard your feedback about the progression system and decided to do this big overhaul in conjunction with the new Mastery system.  Now it is possible to get any item you could wish for in the game at any point you wish (Mastery tree unlocks excluded), just be prepared to put in some effort to earn it!

For those of you sitting on a big Crown stockpile...congrats!

[h1]Revamped Magicks Screen[/h1]
In combination with the Mastery/store rework we've removed crystals as a purchasing currency on the Magicks screen.

NOTE:  Although your crystals will no longer be shown in the UI your current total is recorded.

Got a tonne of crystals?  The next point is for you.

[h1]Crafting Button[/h1]
You will notice the ominous appearance of a crafting button on the UI.  This is not immediately in use yet, but preparation for the crafting system.  Expect to see a use for those crystals here.

[h1]Stasis Magick[/h1]
Does the thrill of battle sometimes get a little TOO thrilling?  Fancy a break now and then?

If so, the new "Stasis" Magick is for you!  You know the little yellow bubble from the start of Duel Mode?  You get one of those, whenever you like!  Beware:  Whatever intended to kill you when you popped your stasis Magick could well still be there to kill you when it wears of...

[h1]Frostbomb Magick[/h1]
This Tier 2 Magick does exactly what it says on the tin, it's a bomb...of frost.  Call down a frozen bomb that after a few seconds will explode, dealing Cold damage in an AOE.

[h1]Consumable Magicks[/h1]
Would you rather try-before-you-buy?  Like to save your mastery points for something else other than Magicks?

You can now purchase consumable Magick scrolls to enable you to use Magicks you don't yet own for a limited number of charges.

Note:  This doesn't change the mechanics of Magicks in any way, or give access to "exclusive" Magicks.  It merely allows those who have not unlocked Magicks yet a method of having access to them, they function the same as if you owned the Magick.

[h1]Crown Packs/Starter Packs[/h1]
In order to complement the new store set-up and progression system we have added new Crown packs and Starter packs.  Starter Packs will contain a mixture of Crowns, Magick Scrolls and Mastery points.

[h1]Netcode Stuff![/h1]
Our network coding Wizard is starting to show the fruits of his efforts, the focus so far has been primarily on beams.  The new changes should be particularly apparent to those with higher latency. 

Note:  We have noticed some weird behavior from the Teleport Magick.  We are on it.

[B]Got any questions? Please check the Q&A thread first![/B]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/202090/discussions/0/618459109268999578/

Regards,
The Wizard Wars Team

notes.title: New patch for Magicka: Wizard Wars is LIVE now!
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

PLEASE NOTE: Servers are down for maintenance. We expect them to be up and running some time this afternoon (CET). Thank you for your patience.

We really wanted to get some bigger balance changes in before we patched, unfortunately though some extra-thorough last-minute QA meant we didn't have the resources needed.  As such please see what we DID fit in below:

[Magicks] Geyser and tornado now has longer telegraphs, tornados speed increased, both magicks now have shorter duration, shorter air time for caught players and longer cast-animation (from 0.8sec to 2sec).

[Magicks] Fixed proper teleport settings (3 years in the making), changed max distance from 10 to 7.5m, min from 2 to 1m.

[Spells] Lightning is now blocked by storms and not barriers, initial arc width reduced from 37.5 to 30 degrees.

As I said, we DID have some other changes on the cards, I'll try and get NDKarlsson to pop onto the forums with a post and we can have a proper chat about them. :)

Additionally, these are the changes you will see rolling out today.

[h1]New Mastery Progression Tree[/h1]
We've completely reworked how a Wizard progresses in their pursuit of battleground domination.  In addition to the store format we have now we have implemented a "Mastery" tree. 


Simply put, it's a great big beast of a tree that allows you to choose where you want to specialise your Wizard, you can choose to build along a particular element specialisation, or work on many at the same time.  The choice is yours.


Mastery Tokens will be awarded at the end of round, so those unscrupulous Wizards who tend to flee from battle will wish to re-think their decisions.

Important Note:  Any existing items you own, regardless where they may appear in the Mastery tree are still owned and useable by you.  Anything you owned/could use before theses changes remains the same.

[h1]Random Loot at Round End[/h1]
On the subject of reasons to stick around until the end of a round, random free stuff!

Now at the end of round you can be gifted with any number of goodies, it may be crowns, it could be Mastery Tokens, it could be a robe.  Who doesn't like extra chances at shiny stuff? :)

[h1]Level Locks Removed, All Items Purchased With Crowns[/h1]
This one is a biggie.  All level locks have been removed from items, as have real-money prices.  From here on out all purchases will be made with Gold Crowns.

We heard your feedback about the progression system and decided to do this big overhaul in conjunction with the new Mastery system.  Now it is possible to get any item you could wish for in the game at any point you wish (Mastery tree unlocks excluded), just be prepared to put in some effort to earn it!

For those of you sitting on a big Crown stockpile...congrats!

[h1]Revamped Magicks Screen[/h1]
In combination with the Mastery/store rework we've removed crystals as a purchasing currency on the Magicks screen.

NOTE:  Although your crystals will no longer be shown in the UI your current total is recorded.

Got a tonne of crystals?  The next point is for you.

[h1]Crafting Button[/h1]
You will notice the ominous appearance of a crafting button on the UI.  This is not immediately in use yet, but preparation for the crafting system.  Expect to see a use for those crystals here.

[h1]Stasis Magick[/h1]
Does the thrill of battle sometimes get a little TOO thrilling?  Fancy a break now and then?

If so, the new "Stasis" Magick is for you!  You know the little yellow bubble from the start of Duel Mode?  You get one of those, whenever you like!  Beware:  Whatever intended to kill you when you popped your stasis Magick could well still be there to kill you when it wears of...

[h1]Frostbomb Magick[/h1]
This Tier 2 Magick does exactly what it says on the tin, it's a bomb...of frost.  Call down a frozen bomb that after a few seconds will explode, dealing Cold damage in an AOE.

[h1]Consumable Magicks[/h1]
Would you rather try-before-you-buy?  Like to save your mastery points for something else other than Magicks?

You can now purchase consumable Magick scrolls to enable you to use Magicks you don't yet own for a limited number of charges.

Note:  This doesn't change the mechanics of Magicks in any way, or give access to "exclusive" Magicks.  It merely allows those who have not unlocked Magicks yet a method of having access to them, they function the same as if you owned the Magick.

[h1]Crown Packs/Starter Packs[/h1]
In order to complement the new store set-up and progression system we have added new Crown packs and Starter packs.  Starter Packs will contain a mixture of Crowns, Magick Scrolls and Mastery points.

[h1]Netcode Stuff![/h1]
Our network coding Wizard is starting to show the fruits of his efforts, the focus so far has been primarily on beams.  The new changes should be particularly apparent to those with higher latency. 

Note:  We have noticed some weird behavior from the Teleport Magick.  We are on it.

[B]Got any questions? Please check the Q&A thread first![/B]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/202090/discussions/0/618459109268999578/

Regards,
The Wizard Wars Team
